I didn't commit anything more, because none of the remaining changes are from this task. All of them were already there when I started:

- **`tt_metal/third_party/tt_ops_code_gen`**: a submodule pointer change I didn't make.
- **`ttnn/ttnn/operations/g6_expand/` and `g6_interleaved_to_sharded/`**: other ops, probably from parallel agents.
- **`ttnn/ttnn/operations/g6_zeros/pipeline_logs/`**: written by the orchestrator, not by me.

The hook says to stage only files I created or modified, so I've left these alone. All of my g6_zeros work (op file, program descriptor, writer kernel, breadcrumbs, probe) is in commit `a0435a28115`.
